lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath guramukh jeetiaa bahur na jooai haar ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is successful in this priceless human life; he shall not lose it in the gamble ever again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar prabh ke gun gaavah pooran sabad beechaar ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮੯॥੧੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan daas jan teraa punah punah namasakaar ||2||89||112||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves; over and over again, he bows in humble reverence to You. ||2||89||112||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pothee paramesar kaa thaan ||
lines.translation: This Holy Book is the home of the Transcendent Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gaavahi gun gobi(n)d pooran braham giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has the perfect knowledge of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal mun lochahi birale laagai dhiaan ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas and seekers and all the silent sages long for the Lord, but those who meditate on Him are rare.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi kripaal hoi meraa suaamee pooran taa ko kaam ||1||
lines.translation: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is merciful - all his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bhai bha(n)jan tis jaanai sagal jahaan ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, knows the whole world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੯੦॥੧੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal bisar nahee mere karate ihu naanak maa(n)gai daan ||2||90||113||
lines.translation: May I never forget You, even for an instant, O my Creator Lord; Nanak begs for this blessing. ||2||90||113||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੂਠਾ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: voothaa sarab thaaee mehu ||
lines.translation: The rain has fallen everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anad ma(n)gal gaau har jas pooran pragatio nehu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Singing the Lord's Praises with ecstasy and bliss, the Perfect Lord is revealed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਊਨ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis jal nidh oon thaau na kehu ||
lines.translation: On all four sides and in the ten directions, the Lord is an ocean. There is no place where He does not exist.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa nidh gobi(n)d pooran jee daan sabh dehu ||1||
lines.translation: O Perfect Lord God, Ocean of Mercy, You bless all with the gift of the soul. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sat har sat suaamee sat saadhasa(n)gehu ||
lines.translation: True, True, True is my Lord and Master; True is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਭਰਮੇਹੁ ॥੨॥੯੧॥੧੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sat te jan jin parateet upajee naanak nah bharamehu ||2||91||114||
lines.translation: True are those humble beings, within whom faith wells up; O Nanak, they are not deluded by doubt. ||2||91||114||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobid jeeu too mere praan adhaar ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, You are the Support of my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sahaaee tum hee too mero paravaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are my Best Friend and Companion, my Help and Support; You are my family. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar masatak dhaario merai maathai saadhasa(n)g gun gaae ||
lines.translation: You placed Your Hand on my forehead; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sabh phal paae rasak raam naam dhiaae ||1||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, I have obtained all fruits and rewards; I meditate on the Lord's Name with delight. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: abichal neev dharaaee satigur kabahoo dolat naahee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has laid the eternal foundation; it shall never be shaken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੨॥੯੨॥੧੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak jab bhae daiaaraa sarab sukhaa nidh paa(n)hee ||2||92||115||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak has become merciful to me, and I have been blessed with the treasure of absolute peace. ||2||92||115||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nibahee naam kee sach khep ||
lines.translation: Only the true merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, stays with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਨਿਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਲੇਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laabh har gun gaai nidh dhan bikhai maahi alep ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of wealth, and earn your profit; in the midst of corruption, remain untouched. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagal sa(n)tokhe aapanaa prabh dhiaai ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures find contentment, meditating on their God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ratan janam apaar jeetio bahuR jon na paai ||1||
lines.translation: The priceless jewel of infinite worth, this human life, is won, and they are not consigned to reincarnation ever again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal gobid bhaiaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the Universe shows His kindness and compassion, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈ ਲਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥੯੩॥੧੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: har charan raas naanak paaee lagaa prabh siu ra(n)g ||2||93||116||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he is imbued with the Love of God. ||2||93||116||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee ree pekh rahee bisamaad ||
lines.translation: O mother, I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad dhunee meraa man mohio acharaj taa ke svaad ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind is enticed by the unstruck celestial melody; its flavor is amazing! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਅਹਿਲਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa ba(n)dhap hai soee man har ko ahilaad ||
lines.translation: He is my Mother, Father and Relative. My mind delights in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਮਾਦ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gaae gun gobi(n)d binasio sabh paramaad ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my illusions are dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੋਰੀ ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਖਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: doree lapat rahee charanah sa(n)g bhram bhai sagale khaad ||
lines.translation: I am lovingly attached to His Lotus Feet; my doubt and fear are totally consumed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੯੪॥੧੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: ek adhaar naanak jan keeaa bahur na jon bhramaad ||2||94||117||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has taken the Support of the One Lord. He shall not wander in reincarnation ever again. ||2||94||117||
